_comment: HK City Monitor — data source registry. One entry per candidate source. `probe_sources.py` tests every URL here and writes SOURCES.md + data/sources_report.json. status/verified_at are filled in BY THE PROBE, never by hand. To add a source: append an object, run python3 scripts/probe_sources.py.

_schema.id: stable id, used as the layer/panel key in code
_schema.group: cameras | weather | transport | border | aviation | marine | civic | news | market | geospatial | global
_schema.name: human label (Traditional Chinese preferred)
_schema.type: json | csv | xml | rss | image | html
_schema.url: the URL the app should actually fetch
_schema.candidates: optional list of alternative URLs to try if url fails (used to resolve unknowns)
_schema.hk_filter: true if it is a global source that needs a Hong Kong bbox/param filter
_schema.notes: gotchas, licence, CORS, why it matters
_schema.todo: true if this is still an unresolved candidate

sources.name: 運輸署 交通快拍攝影機位置
sources.notes: UTF-16LE with a DOUBLE BOM (\xff\xfe\xff\xfe) and tab-delimited. Columns: key, region, district, description, easting, northing, latitude, longitude, url. Python's utf-16 codec leaves a stray \ufeff on the first field name — strip it or every row reads empty.

sources.name: 運輸署 交通快拍圖像（單張）
sources.notes: 1013 cameras. 320x240 JPEG ~30KB. May answer 301/302 — follow redirects. Key list from td_camera_list. Timestamp is burned into the image by TD.

sources.name: 天文台 天氣攝影機（單站 HD）
sources.notes: 34 stations verified 200. URL pattern: wxinfo/aws/hko_mica/{lower}/{latest_HD_|latest_}{UPPER}.jpg. Station codes come from www.hko.gov.hk/en/wxinfo/ts/index_webcam.htm. HD is ~462KB, the non-HD variant ~88KB.

sources.name: 天文台 天氣攝影機目錄頁
sources.notes: Source of the 34 station codes. Not machine-readable — parse once, hardcode the list.

sources.name: 天文台 天氣警告一覽
sources.notes: CORS allow-origin * so the browser can fetch directly. Returns {} when no warning is in force. Otherwise keyed by warning code with name, code, actionCode, issueTime, updateTime, expireTime.

sources.name: 天文台 詳細天氣警告資訊
sources.notes: Full warning text, useful for a detail drawer.

sources.name: 天文台 本港現況（溫度、濕度、雨量、紫外線）
sources.notes: temperature.data[] per place, humidity, rainfall.data[] per 18 districts, uvindex, icon. recordTime/updateTime fields carry the observation time.

sources.name: 天文台 九天天氣預報
天文台 特別天氣提示
sources.notes: Returns a nearly-empty body when nothing is active.

sources.name: 天文台 潮汐資料
sources.notes: SOLVED: tide is HHOT (UPPERCASE) and lives on opendata.php, NOT weather.php. Needs station (QUB, CCH, ...) + year; month/day/hour optional. HLT returns astronomical high/low tides. Both verified 200 JSON.

sources.name: 天文台 環境伽馬輻射水平
sources.notes: SOLVED: ambient gamma dose rate is dataType=RYES (Weather and Radiation Level Report) on opendata.php. Needs station + date (YYYYMMDD, up to yesterday). The earlier guesses rmn/radiation were wrong.

sources.name: 天文台 地震速報
sources.notes: SOLVED: earthquakes live on a SEPARATE endpoint, earthquake.php — not weather.php. qem = worldwide M6+ quick report (lat/lon/mag/region/ptime); feltearthquake = locally felt tremors (returns {} when none, which is a valid empty result, not an error).

sources.name: 天文台 天氣雷達圖（256km）
sources.notes: FOUND. URL is TIMESTAMPED: .../rad_256_png/2d256nradar_{YYYYMMDDHHMM}.jpg (~88KB). Images refresh every ~6 minutes, so the app must build the current timestamp (try now, then step back 6/12 minutes until a 200). The sample above was live when probed; the fixed sample will eventually 404 — that is expected, not a broken source.

sources.name: 天文台 衛星雲圖
sources.notes: FOUND. Also a TIMESTAMPED path under /wxinfo/intersat/satellite/image/asia/ — the filename carries a date plus an offset token, so the exact naming rule still needs pinning. ~216KB.

sources.name: 運輸署 行車速度圖
sources.notes: REAL PATHS NOT FOUND: resource.data.one.gov.hk/td/speedmap.xml returns 404 (the 404 body is a decoy PHP index that lists paths which do not exist). Use td_traffic_speed_city (JSON) instead; for XML find the current TIS path on data.gov.hk.

sources.name: 運輸署 行車時間顯示器
sources.notes: REAL PATH NOT FOUND: resource.data.one.gov.hk/td/journeytime.xml returns 404. See the City Dashboard journey-time dataset on data.gov.hk.

sources.name: 運輸署 特別交通消息
sources.notes: Also available in en and sc. Good event-feed source for the map.

sources.name: 行車速度圖（City Dashboard 版，JSON）
sources.notes: JSON twin of the TIS XML — much easier for a static front end.

sources.name: 運輸署 實時停車場空位
sources.notes: Real-time vacancy counts. The JSON body starts with a UTF-8 BOM — decode as utf-8-sig or json.loads throws. Key: car_park[].

sources.name: 實時空置車位（一站式整合版）
sources.notes: Merges TD and Kai Tak (start-up Kowloon East) car park feeds.

sources.name: 城巴／新大嶼山巴士 ETA
sources.notes: Batch endpoint — a GET returns 422, it needs a POST body of stop ids. Also has per-route ETA endpoints under rt.data.gov.hk.

sources.name: 保安局「口岸通」陸路管制站情況
sources.notes: The human page. The machine-readable data is sb_bwt_json (/bwt/json/overview_tc.json) — use that; do not parse this HTML.

sources.name: 香港出行易 管制站狀況
sources.notes: Page is a ~3.5KB JS app. Find its data endpoint. Covers passenger and private-car channels.

sources.name: 入境處 13 個出入境管制站＋開放時間
sources.notes: Static list of 13 control points with opening hours. Hardcode once — lets the UI show 現正開放／已關閉 without any live source.

sources.name: adsb.lol 香港範圍航班（社群 ADS-B）
sources.notes: NO KEY, NO REGISTRATION, and the best of the free ADS-B mirrors: verified 52 aircraft on the HK 100nm circle. Path is /v2/point/{lat}/{lon}/{radius_nm}. Use this as the primary flights layer.

sources.name: OpenSky Network 香港 bbox
sources.notes: Verified 26 aircraft in the HK bbox anonymously. Rate-limited without an account, so it is the fallback mirror rather than the primary. Free account raises the limit.

sources.name: AISStream 船隻 AIS（WebSocket）
sources.notes: THE ONLY genuinely free live AIS feed — global terrestrial receivers, free API key, WebSocket with a bounding-box subscription. Three things to be honest about: (1) it is terrestrial, so vessels roughly 40nm offshore vanish; (2) the vendor's own coverage notes are strongest in European/Atlantic waters and weakest in Asia, which is exactly where HK is — so HK coverage is UNPROVEN, not assumed; (3) it cannot run from a static page, it needs a persistent VPS collector. Measure before building: python3 scripts/test_ais_coverage.py --minutes 10. Dark ships (AIS switched off) need paid satellite AIS and are out of scope.

sources.name: 康文署 康體活動節目（未來約 1.5 個月）
sources.notes: This is the 'what's on soon' feed. Note the http (not https) scheme. Try the https variant too and prefer it if it works.

sources.name: 康文署 康體設施使用率（年度）
sources.notes: Annual statistics only — NOT live booking availability. Do not present as real-time.

sources.name: 漁護署 郊野公園封閉山徑
sources.notes: Live closure layer (7 features, all 'Temporary closed'). Fields TRAIL_ID, TRAIL_NAME_EN/TC, LOCATION_EN/TC, STATUS_EN/TC, EFFECTIVE_DATE, EXPECTED_EXPIRY_DATE. Good hiking-safety layer; also reachable via the CSDI file-api form.

sources.name: 香港公眾假期
sources.notes: VERIFIED. Covers 2025-01 to 2027-12, 17 general holidays in 2026. The JSON body has a UTF-8 BOM — decode utf-8-sig. Also a valid RFC5545 .ics. This is 1823 (the government contact centre) publishing the official holiday calendar.

sources.name: 政府新聞公報 RSS（全部）
sources.notes: VERIFIED valid RSS 2.0, ~478KB, ~100 items. NOTE: general.xml (no suffix) is 404. Publish TITLE + LINK ONLY — never republish article bodies.

sources.name: 消防處 新聞公報
sources.notes: Find an RSS/JSON form of this list if one exists.

sources.name: Yahoo Finance 恒生指數
sources.notes: NO CORS header — must be proxied server side (nginx proxy_pass, 3 lines). Verified working: ^HSI 24750.78 HKD, ^HSCE, 0700.HK, 9988.HK, 3690.HK, 1810.HK, 0005.HK, 0388.HK, 1299.HK, 0939.HK also work. DELAYED — must be labelled 延遲報價 in the UI.

sources.name: CoinGecko 加密貨幣
sources.notes: Free tier is rate-limited but keyless.

sources.name: CARTO dark-matter 底圖 style
sources.notes: Keyless vector basemap style for MapLibre. 93 layers, CJK-capable font stacks (HanWangHeiLight / NanumBarunGothic), glyph server at tiles.basemaps.cartocdn.com/fonts/{fontstack}/{range}.pbf. MUST be referenced as a style URL — passing it as an inline style object to MapLibre 4.7.x silently fails.

sources.name: CSDI 空間數據共享平台 API
sources.notes: VERIFIED — this is the reusable CSDI access pattern, two forms: (a) whole-dataset GeoJSON via /csdi-webpage/file-api?dataset_id=<id>&format=geojson&layer_name=<layer>; (b) ArcGIS FeatureServer at /server/rest/services/common/<dataset_id>/FeatureServer/0/query?where=1=1&outFields=*&f=geojson which ECHOES the Origin header, so it is CORS-open and usable straight from the browser. WFS GetFeature also works (typeNames=csdi:<layer>, outputFormat=geojson — use 'geojson' not 'json').

sources.name: 地政總署 地址搜尋（ALS / Location Search API）
sources.notes: VERIFIED and this is the geocoder the app needs. REAL HOST IS www.als.gov.hk (the older als.ogcio.gov.hk / geodata.gov.hk guesses were wrong). Send Accept: application/json (defaults to XML). CORS is '*' so the browser can call it directly. Returns SuggestedAddress[] with GeospatialInformation{Latitude,Longitude,Easting,Northing} and a GeoAddress code. Whole address dataset: https://www.als.gov.hk/data/ALS-GeoJSON.zip. Use this to geocode news/event text — never let an LLM invent coordinates.

sources.name: USGS 地震（香港 bbox）
sources.notes: Keyless. Empty result near HK is expected and correct — widen the bbox for a regional view.

sources.name: NASA EONET 自然事件
sources.notes: Storms, wildfires, floods. Keyless. Large responses — filter client side by bounding box if the bbox param is unsupported.

sources.name: Open-Meteo 格網天氣（香港）
sources.notes: Keyless, CORS-friendly. Useful as a gridded cross-check against HKO station readings.

sources.name: 消委會 油價資訊通（車用燃油價格）
sources.notes: Every oil company's retail price AND after-discount price per station, plus weekly offers. NO official API — it is a server-rendered Typo3 site (plain GET, stable paths such as /tc/price, /tc/station, /tc/today-discount), so it is scrapeable without a browser, but it is still scraping. A third party (talklivelihood.hk) already republishes it. BEST MOVE: ask the Consumer Council for a feed — a public body publishing a consumer tool should be able to publish data. No price data on data.gov.hk (only complaints statistics).

sources.name: 消委會 網上價格一覽通（超市格價）
sources.notes: Supermarket prices across the major chains (惠康, 百佳, Market Place, AEON, 大昌, city'super...) for hundreds of product categories. Hierarchical server-rendered URLs (/opw/list/{cat}/{sub}/{subsub}) but the product pages carry NO prices in the HTML — prices arrive via an AJAX call that still needs reversing. Higher effort and higher fragility than the fuel tool. Prefer asking for a feed.

sources.name: 消委會 嬰幼兒奶粉價格調查
sources.notes: Part of the Consumer Council price-comparison toolkit. Check whether the survey is published as a table or a PDF.

sources.name: 消委會 投訴統計
sources.notes: The ONLY Consumer Council dataset on data.gov.hk. Resolve the real CSV resource URL via the CKAN API.

sources.name: 運輸署 公共交通路線及收費（巴士/小巴/渡輪/電車）
sources.notes: GOTCHA: the CSVs are DAILY CHANGE LOGS only (ROUTE_ID, ROUTE_SEQ, CHANGE = ADD/DELETE/UPDATE) — they contain NO fares. The real fare tables are MS Access files, e.g. FARE_BUS.mdb at 32.9 MB. Full family available: ROUTE_/RSTOP_/STOP_/FARE_ x BUS, GMB (minibus), FERRY, TRAM, PTRAM. To use it: convert the .mdb to SQLite/Parquet once with mdbtools, then apply the daily deltas. A one-off converter is a genuinely useful open-source contribution and the only free source of complete HK public-transport fares.

sources.name: 康文署 SmartPLAY 康體活動（現行，取代舊 leisure_prog）
sources.notes: THE current 'what's on soon' feed — ~8,700 records with ~7,200 upcoming. ~17MB, so fetch it on a schedule from the VPS and slim it to a static JSON; never ship 17MB to the browser. Fields include ACTIVITY_NO, EN_PGM_NAME, PGM_START/END_DATE, EN_VENUE, FEE, QUOTA, PLACES_LEFT. This supersedes lcsd_leisure_prog, which is frozen and stale.

sources.name: 康文署 文化／演藝節目
sources.notes: Current cultural programme listings, ~1.9MB. <events> with id, titlec/titlee, cat1/cat2, predateC.

sources.name: 康文署 節目日期
sources.notes: Maps event id to performance dates (<indate>). Join with events.xml and venues.xml.

sources.name: 康文署 節目場地（含經緯度）
sources.notes: Venue id, name, latitude/longitude — enough to put cultural events on the map.

sources.name: 康文署 場地總表（開放時間、休息日、地址）
sources.notes: 629 venues across 15 categories. Has OpeningHour_en/cn AND ClosedOn_en/cn AND PublicHolidayOpeningHour — this is how the UI answers '邊個場今日開唔開' without any live source. A temporary-closure feed does NOT exist (checked); holiday.xml returns an empty <holiday/>.

sources.name: URBTIX 售票節目（每日批次）
sources.notes: The URL embeds the publish date as YYYYMMDD — substitute today's date (a future date 404s). ~550KB, <BATCH><TOTAL><EVENTS> with ST_DATE/ED_DATE, EVENT_CODE, name, REFERENCE_LINK, CATEGORY.

sources.name: 康文署 體育館（CSDI）
sources.notes: Layer 'SC'. Dataset id lcsd_rcd_1629267205215_31341.

sources.name: 康文署 網球場（CSDI）
sources.notes: Layer 'geotagging'. Dataset id lcsd_rcd_1629267205215_84141.

sources.name: 康文署 羽毛球場（CSDI）
sources.notes: Layer 'geodatastore'. Dataset id lcsd_rcd_1629267205214_38344.

sources.name: 康文署 籃球場（CSDI）
sources.notes: Layer 'geodatastore'. Dataset id lcsd_rcd_1629267205215_38105.

sources.name: 康文署 圖書館（CSDI）
sources.notes: Layer 'LIBRARY'. Dataset id lcsd_rcd_1629267205214_44807.

sources.name: 康文署 博物館（CSDI）
sources.notes: Layer 'MUSEUM'. Dataset id lcsd_rcd_1629267205214_78787.

sources.name: 康文署 公園、動物園及花園（CSDI）
sources.notes: Layer 'PARKS'. Dataset id lcsd_rcd_1629267205215_19292.

sources.name: 康文署 渡假營（CSDI）
sources.notes: Layer 'HC'. Dataset id lcsd_rcd_1629267205214_83172.

sources.name: 康文署 燒烤場（CSDI）
sources.notes: Layer 'LCSD_BBQ'. Dataset id lcsd_rcd_1634540957025_61259.

sources.name: 漁護署 郊野公園封閉設施
sources.notes: Live closure layer. FAC_ID, FACILITY_TYPE_EN/TC, LOCATION_EN/TC, STATUS_EN/TC, EFFECTIVE_DATE (epoch ms), EXPECTED_EXPIRY_DATE.

sources.name: 政府新聞網 治安（法治）分類 feed
sources.notes: The 治安 topic feed. Other topics follow the same pattern: admin, finance, environment, health, infrastructure, school_work, city_life. Title + link only in our UI.

sources.name: 地政總署 Location Search API（GeoInfo Map）
sources.notes: VERIFIED on the NEW hostname www.map.gov.hk (migrated from geodata.gov.hk around 2026-05-04). CORS '*'. Returns name/address/district in ZH+EN plus HK1980 grid x/y. Use ALS for addresses and this for place names.

sources.name: 環保署 空氣質素健康指數（各監測站，RSS）
sources.notes: FOUND — the official EPD feed (data.gov.hk dataset hk-epd-airteam-current-aqhi-of-individual-air-quality-monitoring-stations). Each item's title is the station name and the description carries '<station> - <type>: <AQHI> <risk>'. ChT/ChS variants alongside. Host is www.aqhi.gov.hk — the bare aqhi.gov.hk does not resolve.

sources.name: 環保署 AQHI 過去 24 小時逐站讀數
sources.notes: The file the aqhi.gov.hk page itself loads. It is JavaScript, not JSON: 'var station_24_data = [...]'. Strip the 'var ... = ' prefix then parse. Per-station hourly rows with StationID, DateTime, StationNameEN/CT/CS, aqhi and NO2/O3/SO2/CO/PM10/PM25 — i.e. the full pollutant breakdown, ~226KB.

sources.name: 環保署 AQHI 預報／健康風險級別
sources.notes: 'var aqhi_report = [...]' with DateTime, StationTypeEN, AQHIRiskEN, AQHIRange. Strip the var prefix.

sources.name: 保安局「口岸通」陸路管制站即時狀況（JSON）
sources.notes: SOLVED — this is the JSON behind 口岸通, and it is the highest-value source in the project. updateDate + cpInfoList[]; each control point has code, cpName, openFrom/openTo and arrival/departure, each broken down into resident / visitor / car / cross-border shuttle, with status 1/2/3 for the green-yellow-red level. Keyless. NOTE: there is no Chinese in the path — /bwt/json/overview_tc.json sits directly under www.sb.gov.hk.

sources.name: 九巴／龍運 路線及到站時間（免 key！）
sources.notes: NO KEY NEEDED — data.etabus.gov.hk is KMB's own open data portal. Verified: /route/ lists all routes (~349KB); /route-stop/{route}/{direction}/{service_type} for the stop sequence; /eta/{stop_id}/{route}/{service_type} for arrivals. GOTCHA: direction must be the literal 'outbound' or 'inbound' — O/I/1/2 all return 422 'Invalid direction'.

sources.name: 港鐵 下一班列車（免 key）
sources.notes: Keyless mirror on rt.data.gov.hk — the official opendata.mtr.com.hk Next Train API instead wants a free registration. line=ISL / sta=ADM returns UP and DOWN trains with platform and ttnt.

sources.name: 香港國際機場 航班（免 key）
sources.notes: The public keyless feed hongkongairport.com itself uses (the official AAHK Data Services API wants a free developer account). Add arrival=true&cargo=false to filter. /rest/flights/past also works; /rest/flights/search is 404. ~210KB per request — fetch it server-side and slim it, not per client.

sources.name: 龍運巴士 ETA
sources.notes: Service is live (it answers structured 422 JSON) but the parameter format differs from KMB and is unconfirmed. Cheap to finish — try the KMB path shapes with the lwb prefix.

sources.name: adsb.fi 香港範圍航班（第二個免 key 鏡）
sources.notes: VERIFIED — 42 aircraft, keyless. Note the path shape differs from adsb.lol: /v2/lat/{lat}/lon/{lon}/dist/{nm}. Having two independent keyless mirrors means the flights layer survives one of them going down; interleave them rather than picking one.

sources.name: adsbdb 飛機註冊／機型補充資料
sources.notes: VERIFIED keyless enrichment: callsign to airline/route, and /v0/aircraft/{hex} for registration, type, owner and photo. Cheap way to turn a bare hex+callsign on the map into something a reader understands. Cache it — this data barely changes.

sources.name: airplanes.live（403，唔用）
sources.notes: Returns 403 without credentials. Listed so nobody re-tries it; adsb.lol and adsb.fi cover the need.

sources.name: VesselAPI 船隻位置（免費層，要 key）
sources.notes: REST AIS with a free tier and bbox filters — a candidate fallback if AISStream's terrestrial coverage around HK proves too thin. Not yet verified beyond the marketing page; sign-up needed. Only worth pursuing if scripts/test_ais_coverage.py says NO-GO.
